set.body:
Owner directive (2026-09-01, single-developer mode): the first acquisition court, second half (ledger §6 items 3 and 4): FFmpeg deterministic decode to identified frames, PySceneDetect ContentDetector raw metrics plus boundary-existence and boundary-localization proposals only. Follows bd-01M1FDNN3T4SKZ5ZJN1XGXYNY7 (landing A) under the same ledger §6.1 authorization.

What lands
- media/worker: a uv-locked Python project (scenedetect-headless 0.7.1 at the ledger's pinned wheel sha256 0594131c…, numpy, opencv-python-headless; CPython 3.13) and scenedetect_worker.py, an untrusted worker that reads a request naming a raw BGR24 frame file the JVM produced, verifies its digest, drives ContentDetector through the direct process_frame interface with a StatsManager, and writes raw per-frame metrics plus cut ordinals. It never opens a container and never computes a timestamp.
- Ffmpeg (media): the one admitted extraction (rawvideo bgr24, -fps_mode passthrough, no scale/crop); FrameSet.join binds decoded bytes to the probe's PacketIndex and refuses unless the byte length is exactly one frame per indexed packet.
- ContentDetectorRecipe (every parameter declared; automatic kernel must come back resolved), DetectorRequest (issued from a FrameSet), DetectorOutcome (parsed, not believed), FramesEnvelope/DetectorEnvelope (recorded runs for CI replay).
- BoundaryLocalizationProposal (shot layer; instant = PTS of the first frame of the new shot via the packet index; window between the two frames; raw content_val score; recipe identity; no morphology) and BoundarySearchResult (Draft; empty output is ExaminedNoCandidate on the examined extent, never a negative claim). BoundarySearch.join refuses on: request not describing the frames; outcome answering another request, other frames, or another recipe; partial coverage; unresolved automatic kernel; cut at ordinal 0 / out of range / repeated; incomplete metrics; cut without a score.
- Recorded F0 run: frames envelope (ffmpeg 7.1.1 Homebrew, binary sha256 14c12cd5…, 45 frames, sha256 bb13ca6a…), detector request (threshold 15.0, minSceneLen 2, default weights, MERGE), outcome (cuts at ordinals 14 and 29 → PTS 16000 and 32000, the declared shot starts), detector envelope (worker script sha256, runtime versions). Two consecutive worker runs were byte-identical.
- Courts (BoundarySearchSuite, 11): declared-shot-start localization through the index (and not ordinal×nominal); replay identity and worker substitution; recipe/request/frames/coverage/cut/kernel/metrics/score refusals; empty output coverage; proposal-is-not-a-claim; frame-set byte-count and stream-kind refusals; live ffmpeg + worker court when both are present (never installed).

Threshold note: F0's flat shots differ only in hue (content_val 20.0 at both cuts), below ContentDetector's default 27.0; the F0 recipe declares 15.0. The threshold is a declared recipe parameter bound into every receipt; F1 will declare its own.

Not in this slice
- No F1 Big Buck Bunny excerpt yet (next bead). No morphology or extent claims; no BoundaryClaim construction from proposals; no NarrativeSourceAtlas; no TimedSegment production; no E0 promotion. No project-owned container or SBOM for the worker.
set.title: First acquisition court, landing B: frame extraction, ContentDetector worker, boundary-localization proposals
